entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press 1. For technical support, press 2. For returns or order status, press 3.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name or order number?
Order number is 77-81-B-45. Look, I just need a yes or no. Can I return it?
Understood. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order. Just to follow procedure, can you tell me what the issue is? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Listen, I don't have time for a survey. I had an emergency, ended up in the hospital for an unexpected surgery. My husband's deployment date was moved up right after, it's been chaotic. I just need to return it. So, can you process it or not?
Of course, I completely understand and I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope your recovery is going well. Let me just check the policy for you right now... Okay, I see it was delivered ten days ago.
According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days, so you are well within that timeframe. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Great. Finally. What's the next step?

I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Since you're a VIP member, and given the situation with the hospital, I've also processed this as an expedited refund. You should see the credit back on your card in 1-2 business days, you don't even have to wait for us to receive the item.
Okay. I just got the email with the label. That's fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
